name: Schema Registry and Automated Validation
description: Maintain a central schema registry (index.json) listing all schemas with metadata. Implement CI validation using ajv-cli and spectral. Fail CI if any schema is invalid or non-compliant. Add bun run schema:validate command.
purpose: Prevent schema drift. Every schema is discoverable, versioned, and automatically validated in CI.
acceptanceCriteria: schemas/index.json lists all schemas with metadata
ajv-cli validates all schemas against 2020-12 draft
spectral validates naming conventions and metadata requirements
CI fails on invalid or non-compliant schemas
bun run schema:validate runs full validation suite
New schemas added to registry on creation
Deprecated schemas are marked in registry
